en-GB.title: Praetorium.gg
en-GB.subtitle: Army lists and battle tracker
en-GB.description:
Build Warhammer 40,000 armies and track games from setup to final score.

Choose your faction, units and loadouts, check points as you build, and save or share your lists. When you play, Praetorium adds your CP each turn, checks which stratagems you can use, asks what each card scored and keeps a replay. Play 1v1, 2v1 or 2v2 with friends, or practise on your own.

Compare any two units in the combat simulator, and run groups, leagues and tournaments for the people you play with.

Use Praetorium on the web, phone or tablet. Share battle and roster links, print lists, get battle-action haptics and keep the screen awake while you play.

Praetorium is an unofficial product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Games Workshop. Warhammer 40,000 and related marks belong to Games Workshop.
en-GB.releaseNotes: Improvements and fixes to make building armies and tracking battles smoother.
en-GB.promoText: Build your army, check points as you go and track every battle from setup to the final score.
